message: 新人さんこんにちわ
For now, we'll gather information from our acquaintances.

name: Misasagi
message: 「With all of you from the Student Council gathered here, what business might you have?」
We question Misasagi-senpai, who is holding club activities in a corner of Prier.

name: Synn
message: 「You and your club use Prier quite often, don't you, Senpai?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「It's practically an unofficial clubroom for the Wagashi Club, after all. And what about it?」

name: Synn
message: 「Where is the new Waitress?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Ah, you mean that adorable little dear?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Would you care to have some?」

name: Azel
message: 「I don't want any」

name: Misasagi
message: 「What a coldhearted person you are」

name: Pasta
message: 「Then Pasta will eat it, nya!」

name: Misasagi
message: 「This is the one」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Whoa, she's tiny」

name: Misa
message: 「I wonder if this is okay under the Labor Standards Act?」

name: Ria
message: 「Big Sis gave her permission, so it's fine」

name: Ria
message: 「......Probably」

name: Pasta
message: 「What do you lot want. If you don't have any money, get out, nya. We don't need poor people, nya!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Verbal abuse right off the bat!」

name: Synn
message: 「Ugh...... My very existence was just denied」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It's alright, Mr. President. You may not have any money, Mr. President, but don't you have authority that makes everyone bow down before you?」

name: Pasta
message: 「Even if you have something like that, it's meaningless if you don't have money, nya. Here, only the people who pay money are important, nya」

name: Synn
message: 「......I'm starting to feel like I shouldn't be here」

name: Ria
message: 「Aah, Synn-kun is shrinking smaller and smaller」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Now, now, don't get so worked up. Would you like a bite?」

name: Pasta
message: 「Whoa. You're giving it to me, nya?! You're a good human as always, nya!」

name: Misa
message: 「Won over by a single rakugan sweet... She's just like Sally.」

name: Pasta
message: 「Mmmm. Delicious! I hope this becomes a new menu item soon, nyaa. Then I could mooch some every single day.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You're gonna mooch off the customers?」

name: Ria
message: 「I heard it's going to be added starting next January.」

name: Pasta
message: 「N-No way, nya! That's way too late, nya!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Why is January too late?」

name: Pasta
message: 「W-Well, um, that's a secret, nya.」

name: Ria
message: 「Maybe her part-time job is only a one-month contract?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Even before that, at this rate she's gonna get fired before long.」

name: Pasta
message: 「Hey, poor guy over there, this isn't the time to look all bummed out! Use your authority to make January start tomorrow, nya!」

name: Synn
message: 「Sorry. That's impossible.」

name: Pasta
message: 「You're totally useless, nya!」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Pasta-han.」

name: Pasta
message: 「What is it, good human? Gonna give me another one, nya?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「The kitchen lady is glaring daggers right at you.」

name: Pasta
message: 「Nyaaaaaah! I'm gonna get punished again, nyaaa! Not the Cliffside Agony Chili Pepper, nya!」

name: Misa
message: 「Cliffside Agony Chili Pepper?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Just watch and you'll see.」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah. Caught without a fight.」
Prier. At first glance, an elegant and welcoming space.
And yet! Thanks to its unmatched terrain advantage, it is a no-man's-land under the absolute rule of the kitchen staff who reign over the galley!

name: Pasta
message: 「Funyaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaah!」
Azel walked over to stand beside Pasta, who was twitching all four limbs in pure agony, and readied a digital camera.

name: Pasta
message: 「T-Taking a picture... nya... *tremble*」
No mercy at all.
